rationale: Saori brings deep materials-science expertise from her research at Resonac, a semiconductor and functional materials company, while Lisa is building something at Redbey Lakes LLC as a founder. Their complementary backgrounds—researcher and founder—could create interesting dynamics for exploring how advanced materials innovations might apply to new product opportunities.
intro_message: Saori Miura, meet Lisa Wang — you're coming from opposite sides of the materials and product space and might spark something useful at the hackathon.
